A customer satisfaction study of what goes with the value customers get from a service, by correlation and regression. surveyframe declares the analysis in advance (Pearson correlation, Spearman rank correlation, Kendall rank correlation, Partial correlation, Linear regression) and reports it in APA 7.

## In SurveyStudio

In RStudio, open the Addins menu, choose **surveyframe: Try a demo** and pick `correlation_regression`. The study opens on the Design screen. Plan shows each research question with its method and decision rule, Analyse runs them as declared, and Report writes the APA 7 report.

## In R

```r
d <- sframe_demo("correlation_regression")
results <- run_analysis_plan(d$responses, d$instrument)
render_report(d$instrument, d$responses)
```

## What the report gives

| Research question | Method | What the report gives |
|---|---|---|
| Do use of the service and perceived value go together? | Pearson correlation | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Do use and perceived value go together on ranks? | Spearman rank correlation | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Do use and perceived value go together, by Kendall's tau? | Kendall rank correlation | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| Does the relationship hold once age is held constant? | Partial correlation | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |
| How much value do sessions and networking together explain? | Linear regression | The APA 7 sentence, its table and chart |

The demo's data is simulated, so the site shows no numbers. Run it in SurveyStudio or R to see the results, each marked as demonstration data.
